$comment: THE STEELHEAD BARRIER LIST (T1250, RULINGS S14; T1257 grows it): water a steelhead cannot reach from the sea, held out of 'Pacific streams are steelhead water' (it stays 'possible': a rainbow over 50 cm there is a rainbow). Read by the reach run (pipeline.atlas.reach.steelhead.load_barriers); the reader and the app read the result from the bundle. Two kinds of row in this one file: 'basin' ({basin: an FWA code}: every stream at or below it) and 'upstream_of' ({blk, measure}: everything upstream of that point on that blue line). Every field is required; a row that selects no stream stops the run. Owner 2026-11-27: "Pacific streams now, barriers in 0.11.0 (Recommended)" and "Hold both but make sure it will be compatible with a larger barrier list".

barriers.what: the Mackenzie basin in B.C. (the Peace and the Liard)
barriers.reason: drains to the Arctic Ocean: no sea-run rainbow trout reach it
barriers.source: FWA watershed code group 200; owner 2026-11-27, "Pacific streams now, barriers in 0.11.0 (Recommended)"

barriers.what: the Yukon basin in B.C. (Teslin, Atlin, Tagish)
barriers.reason: drains to the Bering Sea through 3,000 km of the Yukon: no sea-run rainbow trout reach it; stays with the Arctic by the owner's ruling
barriers.source: FWA watershed code group 800; owner 2026-11-27, "Pacific streams now, barriers in 0.11.0 (Recommended)"

barriers.what: the Columbia basin in Regions 1-6 (the upper Similkameen and its feeders, Shrimpton Creek)
barriers.reason: cut off from the sea by dams downstream (Enloe Dam on the Similkameen, Chief Joseph and Grand Coulee on the Columbia, all in Washington; to be sourced in T1257)
barriers.source: owner 2026-11-27, "Hold both but make sure it will be compatible with a larger barrier list"

barriers.what: the Skagit River and its tributaries in B.C., all above Ross Dam
barriers.reason: every B.C. section of the Skagit lies above Ross Dam (Washington), which has no fish passage (to be sourced in T1257). Basin 970's other branch, 970-030628 (Bertrand, Fishtrap and Pepin creeks, to the Nooksack), is not held
barriers.source: owner 2026-11-27, "Hold both but make sure it will be compatible with a larger barrier list"
